_about: The founder's own words: the event / the cars, learned from ten years of racing (pitch notes section 25). Use them word for word; never reword. Used by: /about/why-preparation/ (all), event pages (closing line: an event half), /blog/autodidact/ (opening line: a cars half), the Monday newsletter (one pair a week, by ISO week number).
heading: Ten years of racing taught me this.
pairs: The event asks one question: are you ready?
The event is a few minutes of driving.
The cars are months of work.
The cars are full of them.
The event does not care how hard you worked.
The cars know how hard it was.
The event is where it counts.
The cars are where it's built.
The event is where you arrive.
The cars are how you get there.
The event tells you the truth.
The cars make you earn it.
The event doesn't wait for you.
The event happens with or without you.
The cars depend entirely on you.
The event shows whether you finished.
The cars show whether you started.
closing: The cars are where you learn.
The event is where you are judged.
